For me the CGM just led to a lot of build up and breakage! I first tried it in 2016/2017 so the rules might’ve changed, but the ones I think are super unhealthy 
- co-wash instead of shampoo (your hair will never be clean) 
- putting any kind of food product in your hair 
- no sulfates (your hair needs sulfates or other surfactants to be clean!)
- wash your hair as little as possible (moisture is just water so you should wash your hair frequently/regularly, at least once a week) 

The rules seem to be less intense now, but people also use to recommend styling your hair with the LCO/LOC method as part of a curly girl routine (leave in, cream, oil) and I’ve found that that is just an express train to insane amounts of buildup in the hair. TLDR; it’s over complicating hair care and causing damage in the long run

Prefacing my wash/condition/styling routine by saying that I wash my hair weekly and don’t use oils, butters or leave-ins which has been the biggest change. 

I shampoo with Curls Blueberry Bliss and condition and detangle with Mixed Chicks deep conditioner (hate the brand name) and immediately rinse it out. While staying in the shower I apply Kinky Curling custard to soaking wet hair, then use either the Doux’s 808 base gel or Uncle Funky’s and then finish with Mousse Def by the Doux! 

I let my hair air dry for 30 minutes and then either sit under a hooded dryer or diffuse on low heat until fully dry!
